title: Bab el-Amara gateway
summary: Ptolemy III’s monumental gate occupies a setting where planned pylon towers were not completed.
orientation: South of Khonsu’s temple, on its southern approach.

claims.text: Ptolemy III’s monumental gate occupies a setting where planned pylon towers were not completed.
Vultures decorate its ceiling, a winged sun marks the lintel and protective formulae occur within the passage. The gateway acts as a decorated threshold.
Do not reconstruct the missing flanking towers as if they once stood complete.

citations.locator: Phases of Construction: Nectanebo I; Ptolemy III

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
